guide.storagenexus.page.1:
Storage Nexus

Drawers, a simple storage network, remote tablets, dimensional item links and conduits.

This book covers every block and item. Each item's tooltip also says what it does.
guide.storagenexus.page.10:
Fluid Intake
It reaches the blocks touching it. An Intake Range Upgrade (right-click the intake) widens that to a 5x5 area around and below it.

Right-click it with an empty hand to see what it holds.
guide.storagenexus.page.11:
Storage network
Storage Connector: reads every inventory it touches.
Filtered Connector: only the one it faces.

Inventory Cable links connectors, terminals, Fluid Intakes and Outputs facing it. No power needed.
guide.storagenexus.page.12:
Terminals
Show everything in the network, fluids first. Search with @ to search by mod.
Left-click: take a stack.
Right-click: take one.
Shift-click: to your inventory.
Holding items: left puts in all, right puts in one.
guide.storagenexus.page.13:
Terminal buckets
Empty bucket on a fluid: fill it.
Filled bucket: left-click pours it in, right-click stores the bucket.

Crafting Terminal
Use the recipe book: recipes you can make from the network light up, and clicking one fills the grid from it.
guide.storagenexus.page.14:
Priority & filters
Right-click a connector to set its priority. Items go into higher priority first, and come out of lower priority first.

A filter in a Filtered Connector limits which items it accepts.
guide.storagenexus.page.15:
Dimensional Anchor
Keeps the 3x3 chunks around it loaded. Right-click to switch:

Always: always loaded.
On-demand: only while a tablet uses a terminal there.
guide.storagenexus.page.16:
Dimensional Anchor
Keeps the 3x3 chunks around it loaded.

Right-click to switch:
Always: always loaded.
On-demand: loaded only while a tablet is using a terminal there.
guide.storagenexus.page.17:
Dimensional links
Click a Dimensional Input with a Link Card, then click any Outputs.

Items put in the Input (hoppers work) arrive at the Outputs, any distance or dimension. Outputs push into the block they face.
guide.storagenexus.page.18:
Links, continued
Name a link by renaming the card in an anvil first.

Move an Input: break it, then click the new one with the same card.

Outputs can hold a filter. Transfer Speed Upgrade (Input): 1 = 16 items, 2 = stacks.
guide.storagenexus.page.19:
Conduits
Item conduits: Tier 1 and 2. Fluid conduits: Tier 1 to 3. Higher tiers show a trim: gold for Tier 2 fluid, green for the top tier. Use a higher tier on a conduit to upgrade it.

Wrench: right-click a side to cycle its mode. Sneak + right-click: all its settings.
guide.storagenexus.page.2:
Drawers
1x1: 54 stacks
1x2: 27 per slot
2x2: 13.5 per slot

Right-click the front: insert what you hold.
Double-click: insert all matching.
Left-click: take a stack. Sneak: one.
guide.storagenexus.page.20:
Conduit settings
Colour channel: items only travel between sides of the same colour. Also redstone control, priority, round-robin, a filter and up to 3 Speed Upgrades per side.

Use any full block on a conduit to hide it behind a facade.
guide.storagenexus.page.21:
Filters
Right-click a filter to edit it: click items into its 9 slots, then choose allow or block, and whether to match exactly.

Advanced Filter: matches by item tag.
Fluids: use their bucket.
guide.storagenexus.page.3:
Upgrades
Right-click a drawer or tank with an upgrade to install it.

To take one out, right-click the side or top of a drawer with an empty hand, or sneak + right-click it.
Tanks: empty-hand right-click.
guide.storagenexus.page.4:
Upgrade types
Capacity: Iron x2, Gold x4, Diamond x8, Netherite x16. Several add together.

Lock: empty slots stay reserved for their item.

Void: items that don't fit are deleted. Good for cobblestone farms.
guide.storagenexus.page.5:
Compacting Drawer
Takes nuggets, ingots or blocks (any 9:1 or 4:1 recipe that works both ways) and stores them as one pool.

Take whichever form you need: the top slot is the largest form, the bottom slots the smaller ones.
guide.storagenexus.page.6:
Moving storage
Breaking a drawer, compacting drawer, fluid drawer or tank keeps everything inside, upgrades included, in the dropped item.

Hover over it to see the contents, then place it anywhere.
guide.storagenexus.page.7:
Drawer Controller
Drawers touching it, or each other, within 16 blocks form a cluster.

Right-click it with an item to send it to the drawer that holds it. Double-click: send your whole inventory.
Empty hand: shows its reach.
guide.storagenexus.page.8:
Controller Slave
Place one in a cluster: drawers within 16 blocks of the slave join too.

Hoppers, pipes and conduits can use a controller as one big inventory, and so can a storage network.
guide.storagenexus.page.9:
Fluids
Fluid Drawers hold 32 buckets (2x2: 8 per slot), Fluid Tanks 128. Use a bucket on them to fill or empty.

Fluid Intake: pulls one source block a second into a tank or network next to it. Infinite water is never drained.
